cases.sentence: «А! вот уж и из распивочных пьяные выходят», — подумал ___.
cases.translation: "There, the drunks are already coming out of the taverns," he thought.
cases.explain: «Он» is the subject of «подумал», so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Он взглянул: в правой руке у него отрезанные куски ___.
cases.translation: He glanced: in his right hand were cut pieces of fringe.
cases.explain: «Куски» (pieces) governs the genitive of the material noun that follows it, giving «бахромы».

cases.translation: He rushed to the little window.
cases.explain: The preposition «к» (toward) governs the dative case, giving «окошку».

cases.sentence: Он схватил складной большой ножик и обрезал ___.
cases.translation: He grabbed a large folding knife and cut off the fringe.
cases.explain: «Обрезал» (cut off) is a transitive verb whose direct object takes the accusative: «бахрому».

cases.sentence: Настасья, стуча ___ в дверь, кричала, чтобы он отворил.
cases.translation: Nastasya, banging on the door with her fist, shouted for him to open it.
cases.explain: The instrumental case expresses the instrument of the action «стуча» (knocking), giving «кулаком».

cases.sentence: Он остановился и начал слушать: в ___ всё совершенно спало.
cases.translation: He stopped and began to listen: in the house everything was completely asleep.
cases.explain: The preposition «в» marking location governs the prepositional case, giving «доме».

reading.ru: Так пролежал он очень долго.
reading.question: What is Raskolnikov doing at the very start of this chapter?
options: Lying motionless for a very long time after the murder
reading.correct: Lying motionless for a very long time after the murder
reading.explain: The chapter opens with him having lain like that for a very long time.

reading.ru: Он сел на диване, — и тут всё припомнил! Вдруг, в один миг всё припомнил!
reading.question: What happens the instant Raskolnikov sits up on the sofa?
options: He suddenly remembers everything about the murder
reading.correct: He suddenly remembers everything about the murder
reading.explain: The text says that in one instant he remembered everything.

reading.ru: Страшный холод обхватил его; но холод был и от лихорадки, которая уже давно началась с ним во сне.
reading.question: What causes the terrible cold that grips Raskolnikov?
options: Partly fear and partly a fever that had already begun while he slept
reading.correct: Partly fear and partly a fever that had already begun while he slept
reading.explain: The narrator explains the cold came both from fear and from a fever that had started while he slept.

reading.ru: С изумлением оглядывал он себя и всё кругом в комнате и не понимал: как это он мог вчера, войдя, не запереть дверей на крючок и броситься на диван, не только не раздевшись, но даже в шляпе
reading.question: What does Raskolnikov realize with astonishment about how he came home the night before?
options: He had not locked the door and had thrown himself on the sofa still fully dressed, even in his hat
He had carefully undressed and locked every door
He had never made it home at all
He had left the axe on the table
reading.correct: He had not locked the door and had thrown himself on the sofa still fully dressed, even in his hat
reading.explain: He is astonished he had not bolted the door and had collapsed on the sofa dressed, hat included.

reading.ru: только на том месте, где панталоны внизу осеклись и висели бахромой, на бахроме этой оставались густые следы запекшейся крови.
reading.question: Where does Raskolnikov find traces of blood on his clothing?
options: On the frayed fringe at the bottom of his trousers
reading.correct: On the frayed fringe at the bottom of his trousers
reading.explain: He finds thick traces of dried blood on the fringe where his trousers had frayed at the bottom.

reading.ru: Вдруг он вспомнил, что кошелек и вещи, которые он вытащил у старухи из сундука, все до сих пор у него по карманам лежат!
reading.question: What does Raskolnikov suddenly realize he still has in his pockets?
options: The purse and stolen items from the old woman's trunk
reading.correct: The purse and stolen items from the old woman's trunk
reading.explain: He suddenly remembers the purse and stolen items are still in his pockets, not yet hidden.

reading.ru: Там, в самом углу, внизу, в одном месте были разодраны отставшие от стены обои: тотчас же он начал всё запихивать в эту дыру, под бумагу
reading.question: Where does Raskolnikov initially hide the stolen items?
options: In a hole in the wallpaper in the corner of the room
reading.correct: In a hole in the wallpaper in the corner of the room
reading.explain: He stuffs everything into a torn spot in the wallpaper in the corner of the room.

reading.ru: «Боже мой, — шептал он в отчаянии, — что со мною? Разве это спрятано? Разве так прячут?»
reading.question: What does Raskolnikov realize about his hiding place almost immediately?
options: That it is a foolish, inadequate way to hide the evidence
That it is a perfect hiding place
That he should burn everything instead
reading.correct: That it is a foolish, inadequate way to hide the evidence
reading.explain: He shudders in despair, asking himself if this is really how one hides things, realizing it isn't good enough.

reading.ru: Он сдернул петлю и поскорей стал разрывать ее в куски, запихивая их под подушку в белье.
reading.question: What does Raskolnikov do with the loop (strap) used to carry the axe under his coat?
options: He tears it into pieces and stuffs them under the pillow in the bedding
He burns it in the stove
He throws it out the window
reading.correct: He tears it into pieces and stuffs them under the pillow in the bedding
reading.explain: Realizing he forgot to remove the loop, he tears it to pieces and hides them under the pillow.

reading.ru: Вдруг он вспомнил, что и на кошельке была кровь.
reading.question: What does Raskolnikov suddenly remember about the purse?
options: That there was blood on it too
That he had already thrown it away
reading.correct: That there was blood on it too
reading.explain: He suddenly recalls that there was blood on the purse as well, prompting him to check his pocket.

reading.ru: В эту минуту луч солнца осветил его левый сапог: на носке, который выглядывал из сапога, как будто показались знаки.
reading.question: What does a ray of sunlight reveal on Raskolnikov's boot?
options: Bloodstains on the sock peeking out of his left boot
reading.correct: Bloodstains on the sock peeking out of his left boot
reading.explain: A sunbeam reveals marks on the sock sticking out of his boot, which turn out to be blood.

reading.ru: Окончательно разбудил его сильный стук в двери.
reading.question: What finally rouses Raskolnikov from his feverish state?
options: A loud knock at the door
reading.correct: A loud knock at the door
reading.explain: He is finally, fully woken by a loud knocking at the door.

reading.ru: — Да отвори, жив аль нет? И все-то он дрыхнет! — кричала Настасья, стуча кулаком в дверь
reading.question: Who is knocking and shouting at Raskolnikov's door?
reading.correct: Nastasya
reading.explain: It is Nastasya, banging with her fist and shouting for him to open up.

reading.ru: Тот молча протянул ему серую, сложенную вдвое бумажку, запечатанную бутылочным сургучом.
reading.question: What does the caretaker (dvornik) silently hand to Raskolnikov?
options: A gray, folded paper sealed with bottle-green wax — a summons
reading.correct: A gray, folded paper sealed with bottle-green wax — a summons
reading.explain: The caretaker silently hands him a gray folded paper sealed with wax, which turns out to be a police summons.

reading.ru: — В полицию, значит, зовут, в контору. Известно, какая контора.
reading.question: Where is Raskolnikov being summoned according to the caretaker?
reading.correct: To the police station/office
reading.explain: The caretaker explains that he is being summoned to the police office.

reading.ru: «Пятна есть, но не совсем приметно; всё загрязнилось, затерлось и уже выцвело. Кто не знает заранее — ничего не разглядит.
reading.question: What does Raskolnikov conclude about the bloodstains after examining them again?
options: They are dirty and faded enough that no one who didn't already know would notice them
They are more visible than before
They have turned bright red again
reading.correct: They are dirty and faded enough that no one who didn't already know would notice them
reading.explain: He reasons that the stains are grimy and faded, so someone unaware in advance would notice nothing.

reading.ru: Это была обыкновенная повестка из квартала явиться на сегодняшний день, в половине десятого, в контору квартального надзирателя.
reading.question: What does the summons turn out to be about?
options: An ordinary order to appear at the district police office that day at half past nine
A draft notice for the army
reading.correct: An ordinary order to appear at the district police office that day at half past nine
reading.explain: The summons is simply an ordinary order to appear at the district police office at half past nine that day.

reading.ru: «Пропаду так пропаду, всё равно! Носок надеть! — вздумалось вдруг ему, — еще больше затрется в пыли, и следы пропадут».
reading.question: What does Raskolnikov decide to do with the bloodstained sock?
options: Wear it anyway, reasoning the dust will further hide the bloodstains
reading.correct: Wear it anyway, reasoning the dust will further hide the bloodstains
reading.explain: He decides to put the sock on, reasoning that walking in it will further grind in dust and hide the traces.

reading.ru: На улице опять жара стояла невыносимая; хоть бы капля дождя во все эти дни.
reading.question: What is the weather like as Raskolnikov walks to the police office?
options: Unbearably hot, with no rain for days
reading.correct: Unbearably hot, with no rain for days
reading.explain: The text describes the unbearable heat outside, with not a drop of rain for days.

reading.ru: Лестница была узенькая, крутая и вся в помоях.
reading.question: What is the staircase leading to the police office like?
options: Narrow, steep, and covered in slops/dirty water
reading.correct: Narrow, steep, and covered in slops/dirty water
reading.explain: The staircase is described as narrow, steep, and covered in dirty slop water from the kitchens.

reading.ru: «Денег? Каких денег? — думал Раскольников, — но… стало быть, уж наверно не то!» И он вздрогнул от радости.
reading.question: How does Raskolnikov react when he realizes the summons is about money owed, not the murder?
options: He trembles with relief and joy
reading.correct: He trembles with relief and joy
reading.explain: Realizing it is about a debt and not the murder, he shudders with joy and feels immense relief.

reading.ru: А к нам вот поступило ко взысканию просроченное и законно протестованное заемное письмо в сто пятнадцать рублей, выданное вами вдове, коллежской асессорше Зарницыной,
reading.question: What is the actual matter for which Raskolnikov has been summoned?
options: A promissory note for 115 rubles owed to his former landlady, now transferred for collection
A charge of theft from a shop
reading.correct: A promissory note for 115 rubles owed to his former landlady, now transferred for collection
reading.explain: He is told it concerns an overdue promissory note for 115 rubles issued to the widow Zarnitsyna, his landlady.

reading.ru: Поручик, еще весь потрясенный непочтительностию, весь пылая и, очевидно, желая поддержать пострадавшую амбицию, набросился всеми перунами на несчастную «пышную даму», смотревшую на него, с тех самых пор как он вошел, с преглупейшею улыбкой.
reading.question: Whom does the lieutenant (Ilya Petrovich) angrily turn on after his exchange with Raskolnikov?
reading.correct: The "stout lady" (Luiza Ivanovna)
reading.explain: Still furious, the lieutenant unleashes his anger on the unfortunate "stout lady" instead.

reading.ru: Никакой шум и драки у меня не буль, господин капитэн, — затараторила она вдруг, точно горох просыпали, с крепким немецким акцентом,
reading.question: How does Luiza Ivanovna defend herself against the accusations?
options: She rattles off excuses rapidly in broken Russian with a strong German accent
She bursts into tears without speaking
reading.correct: She rattles off excuses rapidly in broken Russian with a strong German accent
reading.explain: She speaks rapidly, like scattered peas, defending herself in heavily accented, broken Russian.

reading.ru: «Обыск, обыск, сейчас обыск! — повторял он про себя, торопясь дойти; — разбойники! подозревают!» Давешний страх опять охватил его всего, с ног до головы.
reading.question: What terrifying thought seizes Raskolnikov as he leaves the police station?
options: That a search of his room is about to happen
That he will be arrested immediately
reading.correct: That a search of his room is about to happen
reading.explain: He repeats to himself in terror that a search must be happening now, and his earlier fear grips him again.
